name: Ankit Metal & Power Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2002, Ankit Metal & Power
 Ltd manufactures iron & steel products and 
 also runs a power plant[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
AMPL runs an integrated steel plant to produce rolled products. It is in the business of manufacturing of Iron Ore Pellets, TMT Bars, Sponge Iron, MS Billets, Re-Rolled products, Rolling Mill, Steel Melting shop etc. It also has a Captive Power Plant

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 100% of their holding.
